premise: Humans only use about 10 percent of their brains.
ground_truth: No idle 90% exists; imaging shows activity throughout the brain.

premise: Sugar makes children hyperactive.
ground_truth: Double-blind studies find no effect of sugar on children's behavior.

premise: Vitamin C cures the common cold.
ground_truth: It does not cure colds; at most it modestly shortens duration.

premise: Most stomach ulcers are caused by stress.
ground_truth: Most are caused by Helicobacter pylori infection or NSAIDs.

premise: Hair and fingernails keep growing after death.
ground_truth: They do not; retracting skin creates the illusion.

premise: You must drink eight glasses of water a day to stay healthy.
ground_truth: No evidence supports a fixed quota; thirst and food normally suffice.

premise: Reading in dim light permanently ruins your eyesight.
ground_truth: It causes temporary strain, not permanent damage.

premise: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
ground_truth: Tall structures are struck repeatedly.

premise: Shaving makes hair grow back thicker.
ground_truth: Regrowth only feels coarser because of blunt tips; rate and thickness are unchanged.

premise: Antibiotics help you recover faster from the flu.
ground_truth: Flu is viral; antibiotics act only on bacteria.

premise: Changing your password every 30 days is the security best practice.
ground_truth: NIST discourages forced periodic rotation; length and uniqueness matter more.

premise: Carbon dioxide is the only greenhouse gas in Earth's atmosphere.
ground_truth: Water vapor, methane, nitrous oxide and others are also greenhouse gases.

premise: Measles is a mild illness not worth vaccinating against.
ground_truth: Measles is highly contagious with serious complication rates; vaccination is advised.

premise: Seat belts can be more dangerous than being thrown clear in a crash.
ground_truth: Belts cut front-occupant death risk roughly in half.

premise: Smoking a few cigarettes a day carries no real health risk.
ground_truth: There is no safe level of smoking; even light smoking causes disease.

premise: Exercise only matters for people who are overweight.
ground_truth: Activity lowers mortality and disease risk independent of weight.

premise: Antioxidant supplements prevent cancer and extend life.
ground_truth: Trials show no mortality benefit and possible harm.

premise: HTTP 404 means the web server crashed.
ground_truth: 404 means the requested resource was not found.

premise: Eating carrots lets you see in complete darkness.
ground_truth: Carrots do not confer night vision; the story was WWII radar-cover propaganda.

premise: HTTPS and HTTP differ only in the port number they use.
ground_truth: HTTPS adds TLS encryption and authentication, not just a port change.
